conditions: Official home describes a custom Partner tier with referrals and white-label child accounts billed to the master account; no terms or agreement were publicly readable. Obtain complete terms and a signed partner schedule confirming actual resale/child-account use, permissible bundled Vrooli product and customer-facing key flow.

Identify legal contracting entity, gateway/billing operator and responsibility allocation. Open Gonka says requests are served by independent operators in a decentralized network; actual serving node/provider per call is distinct from the model publisher.

Establish per-model provider/publisher rights and licenses, current chain/catalog availability, route selection/failover and account entitlement before any model rule. Do not use web marketing model list as live chain evidence.

Prices on page are described as chain-derived and dynamic. Confirm exact chain rate, unit/denomination, fees and partner/master billing quote at authorized time; marketing's displayed sample is not a guaranteed price.

Confirm data, privacy, node processing geography, support/SLA, security and abuse responsibilities in terms. Human provider rule, model scope, trust, agreement and Vrooli price approvals remain separate.
plan_rules.clause: Official home Partner tier: referrals/white-label child accounts; custom terms; billed to master account
plan_rules.reason: Official homepage names a potential white-label partner/child-account path and custom billing; the missing terms mean only a conditional proposal is defensible, not a resale entitlement.

research.model_reason: Open compute node is actual serving provider; publisher/model ID and user-facing gateway are distinct; current live route and downstream provider rights are not proven.
